claims.statement: The curated region has 31 nodes, 40 directed relations and 7 sources; these are corpus counts, not coverage of mathematics.
The baseline checks 772 records with zero failures: one selected edge on each of 771 connected labelled graphs on 2–5 vertices plus one named six-vertex cycle.
The browser engine agrees on all public outputs for 772 baseline records and 3 separately identified supplemental records.
Eight curated lexical retrieval sanity cases and 961 ordered navigation pairs passed; this is not a semantic-recall or novelty benchmark.
Independent symmetry reproduction compared 15,192 full result dictionaries with zero failures in the frozen finite domain.
The independent 21-round frozen-workload benchmark recorded median direct time 0.2803868 s and symmetry time 0.1129344 s. These are machine- and workload-specific measurements.
The annotated normalized-probability reading predicts commute 1 for K2, while exact computation and the original unnormalized-measure formula give 2.

Electrical and Markov quantities use separately constructed exact systems sharing a generic rational solver; tree enumeration uses subset connectivity. Cross-language agreement alone is not an independent proof.
Canonical-form-indexed graph evaluation reuse has direct prior art; this optimization is not claimed as a globally new algorithm.

This region supplies tested finite computations and one independently checked summary normalization mismatch. It does not establish a new mathematical theorem, a general automatic assumption detector, or complete mathematical coverage.

checks.note: Fresh exact evaluator produced 772 records with zero failures and byte-identical baseline SHA-256 b05d83051ba0f92713c87ced4742d1a902297b998d6f221250bef0f80890dd8c; 75 Python tests passed; 3 supplemental six-vertex cases and all-field Node agreement passed. A later symmetry-test-only path portability edit did not change the audited foundation or conclusions. | Corrected promoted checkout: 75 pytest tests passed; 15,192/15,192 exact dictionaries and 21/21 paired benchmark rounds passed. Independent raw parser reconstructed all inputs, canonical classes, exact equation/oracle outputs, hashes, and aggregates with zero mismatch.

The bounded foundation satisfies the task data/workflow/evaluation semantics. Three distinct coe_explorer outputs were verified verbatim against source rollout lines and precede implementation; encrypted spawn-message bodies leave only textual prompt identity uncheckable. Evidence-bundle assembly and Git commit/push are root-owned post-audit finalization. | Canonical class, full API transport, validation-before-lookup, LRU state, mutation isolation, exceptions, nonedges, tied automorphisms, exact diagnostics, and documentation satisfy the frozen contract.

All 31 node claims and 40 material edges were conservatively reviewed against seven authoritative sources with precise locators; reuse and normalization-case claims were checked against official or original sources. Grady and Klein used primary author/journal web passages because local TLS retrieval failed. No novelty, completeness, empirical-efficacy, or formal-proof overclaim remains. | Primary sources support the mathematical ingredients and provide direct prior art for canonical-graph-indexed evaluation reuse. Only a project-specific optimization claim passes; global novelty and real-world impact claims do not.

Code follows the frozen domain and separation requirements; corpus/search/path/validator and formal-adapter boundaries passed. TypeScript and lint passed. This verifier did not perform browser UI/DOM/visual QA or certify WebMCP runtime behavior. | Final promoted code, export, tests, runners, proof report, README, and runtime records were compared after the last path-only fix. Engine SHA-256 5d4c502a...333e is unchanged and matches both final runner summaries.

limitations: Finite curated region, not all mathematics; no claim of globally novel mathematics or algorithms.
No current corpus entry has been checked in a pinned Lean environment.
The external-summary semantic annotation is manual; its exact separating witness is automated. No error-prevalence estimate or evaluated automatic semantic parser.
Search sanity cases are curated rediscovery checks, not held-out semantic or novelty evaluation.
Original branch response events, roles and timing are retained and independently checked; encrypted original prompt bodies prevent checking textual prompt identity.
Wall-clock benchmark benefit applies to the frozen repeated finite workload; cold or larger graphs can be slower.
Focused WebMCP checks do not establish broad visual, responsive or accessibility QA.
